(3) तटीय सुरक्षा ग्रिड ने बहु-स्तरीय रडार नेटवर्क, गश्ती जहाजों और भारतीय तटरक्षक बल और राज्य समुद्री पुलिस के बीच निकट समन्वय का उपयोग करके राष्ट्रीय समुद्री क्षेत्रों की निगरानी को बढ़ाया है।

questions.question_english:
6.

Which of the following statements regarding
recent border management and coastal security
initiatives is INCORRECT?
(1) The Comprehensive Integrated Border Management System (CIBMS) utilizes smart fencing, thermal imagers, and sensor technology.
(2) Border infrastructure funding has been completely eliminated for land borders to focus exclusively on island territories.
(3) Coastal security grids have enhanced multi-tiered radar networks, patrol vessels, and close inter-agency coordination.
questions.explanation_english: India continues to prioritize land border infrastructure alongside coastal and maritime security advancements. The Comprehensive Integrated Border Management System incorporates smart technology, thermal sensors, and physical fencing along terrestrial borders. Meanwhile, coastal security grids utilize multi-tiered radar networks, patrol vessels, and close inter-agency coordination between the Indian Coast Guard and state marine police to monitor national maritime domains and prevent cross-border infiltration effectively.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। भारत भूमि सीमा बुनियादी ढांचे को तटीय और समुद्री सुरक्षा उन्नतियों के साथ प्राथमिकता देना जारी रखता है। समग्र एकीकृत सीमा प्रबंधन प्रणाली स्मार्ट तकनीक, थर्मल सेंसर और भौतिक बाड़ को भूमि सीमाओं के साथ शामिल करती है। इस बीच, तटीय सुरक्षा ग्रिड बहु-स्तरीय रडार नेटवर्क, गश्ती जहाजों और भारतीय तटरक्षक बल और राज्य समुद्री पुलिस के बीच निकट समन्वय का उपयोग करते हैं ताकि राष्ट्रीय समुद्री क्षेत्रों की निगरानी की जा सके और सीमा पार घुसपैठ को प्रभावी ढंग से रोका जा सके।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Border infrastructure funding has been completely eliminated for land borders to focus exclusively on island territories.
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: India continues to prioritize land border infrastructure alongside coastal and maritime security advancements.

questions.question_english: 89. The Financial Intelligence Unit – India (FIU-IND), under the leadership of Director Satya Pal Kumar, primarily functions as the central national agency for which purpose?
options_english: Directly printing currency notes and minting legal tender coins
Regulating and enforcing foreign direct investment limits
Receiving, processing, analyzing, and disseminating information on suspect financial transactions

questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is 'Receiving, processing, analyzing, and disseminating information on suspect financial transactions to enforcement agencies'. The Financial Intelligence Unit – India, led by Director Satya Pal Kumar, serves as the national agency responsible for financial intelligence.
